groups.title: Beat 4 · the file backend and a real rotation

beats.label: Ask the file backend what it knows
beats.cue: “Backend: file, and nothing stored yet. Note what doctor prints — names, backend, status. It never prints values.”
beats.script: Backend: file, and nothing stored yet. Note what doctor prints — names, backend, status. It never prints values. [[pause:1.5s]] No credentials are involved in this check; a clean exit confirms the local path behaves as described. Backend: file · known: 0 secret(s).

beats.label: Rotate the signing secret
beats.cue: “Atomic write via tempfile and rename, then every subscriber's onRotation handler fires with the name — never the value. They call get() themselves.”
beats.script: Atomic write via tempfile and rename, then every subscriber's onRotation handler fires with the name — never the value. They call get() themselves. [[pause:1.5s]] The terminal is exercising the real implementation locally here, and the verifier expects a successful exit. Rotated SLACK_SIGNING_SECRET (19 chars) via file backend.
beats.command: crewhaus secrets rotate SLACK_SIGNING_SECRET --value s3cr3t-rotated-0001 --backend file

verify.note: rotated SLACK_SIGNING_SECRET (19 chars) via file backend

beats.label: Check the file mode
beats.cue: “Owner-only, 0600. And the name went through a path-traversal guard — a slash, a dot-dot or a null byte is rejected, not sanitized.”
beats.script: Owner-only, 0600. And the name went through a path-traversal guard — a slash, a dot-dot or a null byte is rejected, not sanitized. [[pause:1.5s]] No credentials are involved in this check; a clean exit confirms the local path behaves as described. -rw------- on SLACK_SIGNING_SECRET.

beats.label: Ask the backend again
beats.cue: “One secret known, by name only. That listing is the compliance artefact: who accessed what, when — without ever handing the auditor the secret.”
beats.script: One secret known, by name only. That listing is the compliance artefact: who accessed what, when — without ever handing the auditor the secret. [[pause:1.5s]] No credentials are involved in this check; a clean exit confirms the local path behaves as described. Backend: file · known: 1 secret(s) — SLACK_SIGNING_SECRET, metadata only.

beats.label: Rotate under the running daemon
beats.cue: [needs-key] “No restart, no redeploy. The HMAC verifier picks up the new key on the next request; requests already in flight finish against the old one.”
beats.script: No restart, no redeploy. The HMAC verifier picks up the new key on the next request; requests already in flight finish against the old one. [[pause:1.8s]] This is a live, credentialed step and is intentionally excluded from offline replay. The rotation itself is keyless — what needs a key is the running daemon this beat is proving picks it up.
beats.command: CREWHAUS_SECRETS_BACKEND=file crewhaus secrets rotate SLACK_SIGNING_SECRET --value s3cr3t-rotated-0002 --backend file

verify.note: the rotation itself is keyless — what needs a key is the running daemon this beat is proving picks it up
